situation.name: vampire_human_stoker_king
situation.description: Stoker-King vampire model based on Bram Stoker's Dracula and Stephen King's Salem's Lot. Vampires turn humans into vampires through biting. No vampire slayers. Explosive vampire growth leads to human extinction.

article.name: Mathematical Models of Interactions between Species: Peaceful Co-existence of Vampires and Humans Based on the Models Derived from Fiction Literature and Films
article.author: Strielkowski, W., Lisin, E., Welkins, E.

data.name: stoker_king_simulation
data.place: Numerical simulation with Runge-Kutta 4th order method

params.name: lethal_interaction_coefficient
params.meaning: Coefficient of lethal outcome for vampire-human interaction

params.name: conversion_probability
params.meaning: Probability of human turned into vampire (b=1)

situation.name: vampire_human_rice
situation.description: Rice vampire model based on Anne Rice's Vampire Chronicles. Vampires feed discretely, rarely turn humans, don't need to feed daily. Low conversion probability, no slayers. Delays but does not prevent human extinction.

article.name: Mathematical Models of Interactions between Species: Peaceful Co-existence of Vampires and Humans Based on the Models Derived from Fiction Literature and Films
article.author: Strielkowski, W., Lisin, E., Welkins, E.

data.name: rice_simulation
data.place: Numerical simulation with Runge-Kutta 4th order method

params.name: human_growth_rate
params.meaning: Human population growth rate (calculated from historical data)

situation.name: vampire_human_harris_meyer_kostova
situation.description: Harris-Meyer-Kostova vampire model based on True Blood, Twilight, and The Historian. Vampires coexist peacefully with humans, use synthetic blood, have organized vampire drainers. Allows stable coexistence with cyclical dynamics.

article.name: Mathematical Models of Interactions between Species: Peaceful Co-existence of Vampires and Humans Based on the Models Derived from Fiction Literature and Films
article.author: Strielkowski, W., Lisin, E., Welkins, E.

data.name: harris_meyer_kostova_simulation
data.place: Numerical simulation with Runge-Kutta 4th order method

params.name: human_growth_rate
params.meaning: Human population growth rate (calculated from 2001-2012 data)

params.name: slayer_drainer_effectiveness
params.meaning: Vampire drainer effectiveness (c>0, calculated similar to k)
